बॉक्स ऑफिस पर बन रहा है नया इतिहास, हर तरफ बस इसी फिल्म की चर्चा है! 🎬
डिफ़ेंसर डायरेक्टर Nitesh Tiwari की पौराणिक epic फिल्म Ramayana ने worldwide box office पर 12 दिन पूरे कर लिए हैं। 🌟
फिल्म का worldwide gross collection अब तक 1460.49 crore रुपये पर पहुंच गया है। 📈
सिर्फ 39.51 crore रुपये की दूरी बची है और फिल्म 1500 crore के एलीट क्लब में शामिल हो जाएगी। 🔥
India gross collection 965.34 crore रुपये और overseas gross collection 495.15 crore रुपये हो गया है। 💰
Ranbir Kapoor, Yash और Sai Pallavi की इस फिल्म ने domestic net collection में 800 crore का आंकड़ा पार कर लिया है। ⚡
क्या Ramayana जल्द ही Dhurandhar 2 का रिकॉर्ड तोड़ पाएगी? 🤔

ctx.title: Ramayana Worldwide Box Office: Only 39.51 Crore Away From Becoming The 3rd Bollywood Film To Hit This Milestone!
ctx.summary:
Ramayana stands very close to the 1500 crore milestone globally, becoming the 3rd Bollywood film to do so - worldwide box office report.  
 The post  Ramayana Worldwide Box Office: Only 39.51 Crore Away From Becoming The 3rd Bollywood Film To Hit This Milestone!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The countdown to another historic global milestone has officially begun! Completing 12 days at the worldwide ticket window, director Nitesh Tiwari’s mythological epic has reached an extraordinary 1460.49 crore gross worldwide, standing just 39.51 crore away from breaching the coveted 1500 crore milestone!
With steady weekday momentum holding firm across domestic circuits and international markets closing in on 500 crore, Ramayana is all set to become only the third Bollywood film in history to enter the elite 1500 crore global club, joining an exclusive group occupied solely by Aamir Khan ‘s Dangal and Ranveer Singh’s Dhurandhar 2!
Backed by a rock-solid second Monday performance that pushed its domestic net collections past the 800 crore barrier, Ranbir Kapoor , Yash, and Sai Pallavi continue to rewrite box office benchmarks across both Indian and overseas territories.
Once Ramayana clears the remaining 39.51 crore hurdle, it will stand alongside just two other Hindi-origin blockbusters in the history of Indian cinema to cross 1500 crore globally.
Sitting at 965.34 crore India gross , 495.15 crore overseas gross, and 1460.49 crore worldwide gross after Day 12, Ramayana is simultaneously closing in on three historic landmarks – 1000 crore India gross, 500 crore overseas gross, and 1500 crore worldwide gross!
Achieving 1460.49 crore in just 12 days without any Phase 2 East Asian markets (China, Japan, South Korea) proves the global appetite for Nitesh Tiwari’s epic. Once the 1500 crore mark is officially crossed, Ranbir Kapoor and Yash will turn their attention toward chasing down Dhurandhar 2’s 1850.82 crore as the #2 highest-grossing Bollywood film of all time globally!
